title: Open Flame Smoky Australian Lamb Bowl
description: A smoky and crumbly Australian dish featuring lamb, ciabatta, and paleo-friendly ingredients, served in an earthenware bowl. This meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then remove from heat and set aside.
Add the garlic to the Dutch oven and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the Dutch oven and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Return the lamb shoulder to the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes, then reduce the heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
While the lamb is cooking, slice the ciabatta into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the lamb onto a toasted ciabatta slice, then top with cherry tomatoes and a sprinkle of parsley.
Flambé the lamb with a blowtorch or under the broiler for 30 seconds, until slightly charred.
